# Triage: 37 findings → block / warn / ignore

Categorisation key: **block** = correctness, portability, or maintainability defects that should not enter `main` as-is. **warn** = real signal worth fixing soon but not merge-blocking. **ignore** = cosmetic, low-confidence, or context-dependent style nits.

## Block merge (4)

| ID | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Why it blocks |
|----|--------|------------------|--------------|
| crime_00002 | Temporal Recklessness (`src/date.ts`) | high / 0.62 | 8 direct `Date.now()`/`new Date()` in the dedicated date module. Whole file becomes untestable without monkey-patching. Fix is small. |
| crime_00003 | Half-UTC, Half-Local | high / 0.61 | Same receiver mixes `getUTCFullYear()` and `getMonth()` — produces silently-wrong values that vary by host offset. Correctness bug, not style. |
| crime_00005 | God Function `generateInvoice` (204 lines) | high / 0.55 | 3.4× the domain threshold in core billing. Anything an agent edits here will collide with code it never loaded. Extract-helpers fix is "small" effort per the report. |
| crime_00008 | Localhost-on-Disk `/Users/andrew/...` | medium / 0.53 | Hardcoded user-home path in non-test source — breaks on every other machine and in CI. Quick fix; no reason to merge it. |

## Warn (15)

These have real `agent_risk` ≥ ~0.42 or medium severity and represent genuine maintenance debt, but a reviewer could reasonably accept them with a follow-up issue.

| ID | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Note |
|----|--------|------------------|------|
| crime_00001 | SVG With Embedded Raster | high / 0.70 | High severity, but asset-only — doesn't block runtime correctness. Fix in a follow-up. |
| crime_00004 | Concept Alias Drift (tenant/account/organisation/team/workspace) | medium / 0.58 | Five names for one concept across 5 files — agent confusion guaranteed. Worth a doc-or-rename pass. |
| crime_00006 | Missing Agent Context | medium / 0.53 | No AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/SKILL.md anywhere — orthogonal to this PR but worth landing soon. |
| crime_00007 | Hardcoded `localhost:3000` | medium / 0.53 | Slightly more defensible than 00008 (dev-default), but still belongs behind config. |
| crime_00009 | Timezone Roulette (`new Date("2026-12-25T07:00:00")`) | medium / 0.53 | Two unsafe parses — silently wrong by host TZ. Correctness-adjacent, fix soon. |
| crime_00010 | String Sprinkles "enterprise" (4 files) | medium / 0.52 | Plan literal scattered across api/billing/jobs/ui — strong precursor to duplicated policy. |
| crime_00011 | DST-Naive Day Math (`+ 86400000`) | medium / 0.52 | Drifts twice a year. Cheap fix. |
| crime_00015 | Duplicated Navigation Source (`/settings/billing` labelled "Plans" + "Billing") | medium / 0.49 | Two sources of truth — pairs with 00017. |
| crime_00016 | Unfinished Business (14 markers in `src/todo.ts`, 424/1k LOC) | medium / 0.49 | The whole file is FIXME — at minimum triage before merging. |
| crime_00017 | Route Metadata Drift (4 competing labels for `/settings/billing`) | medium / 0.49 | Same incident as 00015; agent editing one label leaves three stale. |
| crime_00019 | Temporal Recklessness in `src/billing.ts` (7 calls) | medium / 0.46 | Same class as 00002 but in billing; lower because not the dedicated date module. |
| crime_00020 | Test That Proves Nothing ("renders the enterprise plan", 0 asserts) | medium / 0.46 | Test_gap = 0 (zero coverage on this behaviour). False confidence is worse than no test. |
| crime_00021 | False Identity `calculateRefundPreview` (sends email, saves audit) | medium / 0.44 | Misleading name on a side-effecting function in billing — exactly the agent-edit hazard `crimes` exists for. |
| crime_00026 | God File `src/billing.ts` (310 lines, 1.0× threshold) | medium / 0.42 | Right at threshold; flag it but don't block on it alone. |
| crime_00027 | Logic in the Alibi (refund rule lives in a comment) | medium / 0.42 | Prose-only rule about owner/billing-support refunds — encode it. |

## Ignore (18)

Low severity, low agent_risk (≤0.44), or domain-style nits where blocking would be noise. Worth fixing opportunistically; not worth a re-review cycle.

- **Asset/style:** crime_00012 (254 KB PNG, just over "low" threshold), crime_00014 (32×32 icon raster), crime_00013 (one stale doc link)
- **More of the same, smaller:** crime_00022 (3 sync I/O calls — fix when touching the file), crime_00023 (1 `Date.now()` in `api/state.ts`), crime_00024 (one date-string concat), crime_00025 (one `toLocaleDateString()` without locale), crime_00038 (4 TODOs in billing — already flagged by 00026/00027)
- **Naming/shape nits:** crime_00028, crime_00029 (boolean prefix), crime_00030 (option bag), crime_00031 (return shape), crime_00032 (negative flags), crime_00033 (singular/plural)
- **Orphaned destinations:** crime_00034, crime_00035, crime_00036 — confidence 0.65, may simply be in flight; flag the trio in PR comment but don't block
- **Weak test #2:** crime_00037 — already covered by 00020 as the canonical example

## Reviewer summary

> 4 hard blocks (3 high-severity correctness bugs concentrated in `src/date.ts` + `src/billing.ts`, plus a hardcoded `/Users/andrew/` path). The blast radius is small (`crimes` reports 0 importers across the board, so this fixture has no transitive blast), but every blocker is a small-effort fix — there's no reason to ship them. 15 warns cluster around two themes: temporal handling everywhere, and the "billing/plans/subscription/account" naming swamp (00004, 00010, 00015, 00017). I'd ask the author to fix the four blockers in-place and open one issue per theme for the warns. The 18 ignores are real but cosmetic.
